newsitem.title: USA: Meditrust completes $115 mln in investments.
newsitem.headline: Meditrust completes $115 mln in investments.

text.p: Meditrust said on Wednesday that it had completed $115 million of real estate investments during the quarter ended March 31, 1997.
The company also said it had existing financing commitments of about $176 million for ongoing real estate projects as of the same date.
Of the $115 million, $34 million consisted of sale/leaseback financing funded for six assisted living facilities, the company said in a statement.

Permanent mortgage financing of $18 million was provided for a retirement living facility, a nursing home and six assisted living facilities, and $2 million was provided for additions to facilities already in the portfolio, the company said.
Meditrust also funded $22 million for developing three nursing homes, four assisted living facilities and two medical office buildings, the company said.
The remaining $39 million was funded for ongoing construction of facilities already in the portfolio, it added.
Meditrust is a health care real estate investment trust with market capitalization in excess of $2.2 billion, the company said.
